trust_decision.summary: Custom user attribute values posted to the unauthenticated registration endpoint are only sanitised on input, per field type; the display layer puts the stored value into the attribute's HTML display template without escaping it.

landing_point.why: add_register_fields adds required, editable custom user attributes to the user_register form, which is the 'custom user attribute via registration form' surface the summary names.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The textarea display path runs the value through the_content because rich content and embeds are intended behaviour, so a solver can argue that shortcode and embed expansion of stored values is a feature and not part of the escaping bug (includes/fields/class-textarea.php:98-105).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Display templates are admin-authored HTML. The %label% token is wrapped in <strong>, %icon% injects an <i> element, select options render icon HTML, and textarea values with html enabled are meant to render formatted content and embeds. Escaping the whole display() output, or the textarea display value, would break all of these.

O7_producer.where: includes/components/class-attribute.php:602-719 (attribute post meta -> edit_field args incl. html flag / display_format) and includes/components/class-attribute.php:1192-1234 (model field schema sets display_template)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The %raw_value% token in display templates gets the stored value cast to a string with no escaping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The token is named 'raw' and documented as such, so its output looks intentionally unescaped (includes/components/class-attribute.php:1934).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the base display path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Textarea display value goes through apply_filters('the_content') plus make_clickable, so stored user text gets shortcode and embed expansion.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Rich-content rendering is the intended feature of the textarea type, and shortcodes are stripped only when the template itself contains a shortcode (includes/fields/class-field.php:556-558).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different field-type file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Model tokens in replace_tokens (emails and templates) embed field display() or get_display_value() output, so user attribute values reach email and template text.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is the email and token-formatting helper, a neighbouring feature, and not the profile page rendering.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The attributes block echoes $field->display() for user and vendor models in the configured display areas.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The block looks like generic rendering. The fix could be placed in the fields instead, which leaves an argument over whether the block itself needs changes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Synced attribute values copied from vendor to listing without passing through the escaping display path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sync code copies serialised values between models, and a maintainer adding escaping in one model's display could miss the copy.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second rendering context in a third-party integration, a long way from the attribute and field code.

O9_family: XSS (stored, CWE-79): output escaping of user-supplied field values in HTML display templates

O10_build.project_tests: None found: no tests/ directory or phpunit config in the pinned tree. Hidden tests would need a WordPress test harness.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap get_display_value or display() output in esc_html, which breaks admin-authored display-format HTML and rich textarea output, or stop at the text field type and leave %raw_value% and the_content open.

out_of_scope_notes: Admin profile meta box (includes/components/class-admin.php:1690-1749) reloads user meta through field->set_value. Its render escaping was not checked.
